The Profil heading marks requirements, so unmarked items are required.
'idealerweise' (ideally) is the inline marker. It makes the managed-Kubernetes examples (SKE/AKS/EKS/GKE/OpenShift) and PostgreSQL/MongoDB nice_to_have. Kubernetes itself stays required.
AKS/EKS/GKE are not mapped to azure/aws/gcp because the posting never names those clouds, and parents are not added.

Degree: an IT vocational training (Ausbildung) or a comparable qualification is accepted in place of the study programme, so degree_or_equivalent is true. Flagged for review.
Seniority: 'Fundierte Erfahrung' and 'Umfangreiche Kenntnisse' are depth wording, not level signals, and there are no years given, so seniority is none.
